purpose: Exploratory retrospective filtering of all finite stationary-phone samples, independent of frozen QC acceptance, with synthetic-injection signal-preservation checks.
priorInspection: The owner-provided phone recordings and historical BOU replay were already inspected. This is an exploratory method demonstration, not an externally preregistered validation or a clean-target denoising study.

kernel.family: Constant times Matern nu=1.5 plus WhiteKernel

injections.interpolation: Linear interpolation of eleven consecutive one-minute F values to one-second relative perturbations, centered per block; no gaps filled and no amplitudes rescaled.

availability: Offline symmetric/whole-record processing uses future samples; no operational availability or real-time performance claim.
qcPolicy: Existing QC report remains unchanged. Its amplitude/MAD acceptance thresholds are diagnostic-only for this exploration; no valid finite sample is excluded because it failed those thresholds.
limitations: One phone session; no independently known clean-phone target or contemporaneous professional reference.
The fitted smooth component is not identified as instrument drift or geophysical signal.
Synthetic injection is a sensitivity check, not a real phone storm or network observation.
Amplitude retention does not measure total denoising accuracy, causal artifact identification, detection skill or forecast improvement.
No filter is promoted into scientific acceptance or regional reporting by this experiment.
